source.method: design review over the harness extension points; reuses run.sh, grade.sh, candidate-contract.ts, sensitivity-control machinery, arms, and provenance
source.prior_discussion: bug-fix benchmark design: fixed versioned task sets, registry-driven variant generation, repair/regression/robustness/quality axes
implementation_notes: Score schema 3 with a track field; provenance schema 5 on both tracks (schema-4 records are stale by policy).

Registry holds 13 entries: 11 in set v1 plus 2 rotation-headroom bugs. Two original bugs were replaced after calibration: BUG-rel-revalidate (full page.goto navigation always re-renders dynamic pages, so a wrong revalidatePath target cannot fail any detector) and BUG-perf-suspense (Next 16 streams the detail page progressively even without the explicit boundary, measured gap 276ms without it).
BUG-fn-status-precedence is ordered before BUG-fn-boundary so the two loans.ts mutations compose.

Calibration on this host is diagnostic (BENCH_IGNORE_LOAD); the ranked cohort needs a quiet host. Clean tree scores 100, untouched variant scores 40, full-set v1 detects 11/11 with no unexpected failures.
P.streams-shell probe and its sensitivity control were retired with BUG-perf-suspense; the F.post-mutation-state and P.stale-after-mutate bite gap is recorded for the harness_audit owner.
